18. 圖中，$D$ 為 $AC$ 上的一點使得 $BD$ 垂直於 $AC$。若 $BC = \ell$，則 $AB =$

A. $\frac{\ell \sin \alpha}{\cos \beta}$ 。
B. $\frac{\ell \sin \beta}{\cos \alpha}$ 。
C. $\frac{\ell \cos \alpha}{\sin \beta}$ 。
D. $\frac{\ell \cos \beta}{\sin \alpha}$ 。
reasoning: In the right-angled triangle $BDC$, we have $BD = BC \sin \alpha = \ell \sin \alpha$. In the right-angled triangle $BDA$, we have $\cos \beta = \frac{BD}{AB}$, which implies $AB = \frac{BD}{\cos \beta}$. Substituting the expression for $BD$ into the equation for $AB$, we get $AB = \frac{\ell \sin \alpha}{\cos \beta}$.
